title: 第15章 顾清婉第16章 怎么踏马缠上自己了
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 噫~
这话从哪儿说起的呢。
望着面前那一脸着急的赵巧儿，陆远不由得咧嘴笑道：
“啥话哩，咱有手有脚的，干啥让姨养一辈子。”
赵巧儿急了，语气愈发娇嗔：
“那咋啦，姨有的是钱，你跟姨回奉天城，姨给你买套大宅子，以后天天吃香的喝辣的！”
听着赵巧儿的话，陆远咧嘴笑着摇了摇头。
那肯定是不能去的。
听起来好像是很爽，但陆远做人还是有追求的。
有【斩妖除魔】系统在，陆远成为大天师那是早晚的事儿。
怎么能为眼前这点事儿，而放弃将来成为大天师呢。
更何况，说句不好听的，如果陆远真想成为这样的人……
还用得着赵巧儿嘛！
琴姨那边，早就盼着他去住呢。
赵巧儿见陆远摇头不同意，急的直接放下手里的鸡汤，双手搂着陆远一条胳膊娇声软语道：
“去奉天城有啥不好的，拥护啥呀，非得干这要命的活计！”
陆远只能摇头晃脑的开始上价值。
说什么自己是被老头子救的，自己作为他的弟子，肩负光耀宗门的职责等等之类的……
反正基本就是以前咋跟琴姨说的，现在就咋跟赵巧儿说。
这给赵巧儿堵得说不话来。
跟赵巧儿说完后，陆远这才转头望向一旁的许二小立即道：
“下一家是哪儿的？”
此时的许二小也放下了鸡汤，拿出一个小本本，翻开几页查看了一下后，便是望着陆远道：
“陆哥儿，下一家在东林村，距离咱这儿三十里地。
东林村的村长家小孙子，撞邪了，一直发烧不好。”
听到这里，陆远盘算了下。
三十里地，这不远，三四个小时就能到。
下午出发，晚上八点前就能到。
另外撞邪这事儿也好整，陆远现在的身体，也没大问题，就每日正午时分要晒太阳。
当即陆远便是点头道：
“收拾收拾，吃完饭咱歇一会儿就走。”
不过，在走之前，陆远打算去问一下宁远镇的镇长，问问山上那孤坟的事儿。
而陆远这刚一说完，赵巧儿便是紧紧搂着陆远的胳膊无比着急道：
“走啥呀！”
“就算你非得干这活计，那你也得养好伤呀！”
“你看你现在都啥样儿了，还咋去呀！”
“先甭去了，先跟姨回奉天城，姨回去给你找最好的郎中，咱先把病养好！”
content_en:
Oh~
Where did this come from?
Looking at the anxious-looking Zhao Qiaoer in front of him, Lu Yuan couldn't help but grinned and said:
"What are you talking about? We have hands and feet, why should we let my aunt support us for the rest of our lives?"
Zhao Qiaoer became anxious and her tone became more coquettish:
"Well, Auntie has a lot of money. You and Auntie go back to Fengtian City, and Auntie will buy you a big house. From now on, you can eat well and drink spicy food every day!"
After listening to Zhao Qiaoer's words, Lu Yuan grinned and shook his head.
That's definitely not possible.
It sounds very satisfying, but Lu Yuan still has pursuits as a person.
With the [Demon Slayer] system, it was only a matter of time before Lu Yuan became the Great Heavenly Master.
How could you give up on becoming a great heavenly master in the future just for the sake of something like this?
What's more, to put it bluntly, if Lu Yuan really wanted to be such a person...
There is still need for Zhao Qiaoer!
Aunt Qin has been looking forward to him living there for a long time.
Seeing Lu Yuan shaking his head in disagreement, Zhao Qiaoer anxiously put down the chicken soup in his hand, hugged Lu Yuan's arm with both hands and whispered softly:
"What's wrong with going to Fengtian City? What are you supporting? You have to do such a fatal job!"
Lu Yuan could only shake his head and start adding value.
He said that he was rescued by the old man, and as his disciple, he shouldered the responsibility of bringing glory to the sect, etc...
Anyway, basically what I told Aunt Qin before, I will tell Zhao Qiaoer now.
This made Zhao Qiaoer speechless.
After talking to Zhao Qiaoer, Lu Yuan turned to look at Xu Erxiao who was aside and said immediately:
"Where's the next one?"
At this time, Xu Erxiao also put down the chicken soup, took out a small notebook, opened a few pages and checked it, then looked at Lu Yuan and said:
"Brother Lu, the next family is in Donglin Village, thirty miles away from us.
The grandson of the village head of Donglin Village was struck by evil spirits and has been suffering from fever. "
Hearing this, Lu Yuan thought about it.
Thirty miles away, it's not far, you can get there in three or four hours.
Depart in the afternoon and arrive before 8pm.
In addition, the problem of being hit by evil spirits is easy to deal with. Lu Yuan's current health is not a big problem. He just needs to bask in the sun at noon every day.
Lu Yuan immediately nodded and said:
"Pack up, let's rest for a while after dinner and then leave."
However, before leaving, Lu Yuan planned to ask the mayor of Ningyuan Town about the lonely grave on the mountain.
As soon as Lu Yuan finished speaking, Zhao Qiaoer hugged Lu Yuan's arm tightly and said anxiously:
"Why are you leaving?"
"Even if you have to do this job, you still have to heal your injuries!"
"Look at what you're like now, why are you going there?"
"Don't go there now. Go back to Fengtian City with your aunt. She will find the best doctor for you when she goes back. Let's get well first!"
